review.notes: Full review. All nine sampled targets (1.1-4.2) verified against Kevei's notes (12 locators, author's page) and Durrett (2 exercises, author's page); every statement recomputed on degenerate and two-term instances, numerical Checks recomputed (quadrature, root finding, simulation). 36 Mathlib and 10 Tau Ceti declarations opened at the pins. Dependency check: 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 11 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes none of the 11 theorems. Automatic checks: one scanner hit (mentions of PointProcesses as a non-supplier) set aside as a false positive. One small correction (contract wording for two Mathlib convergence lemmas), one format note. For the human reviewers: main source is unpublished lecture notes; Durrett's page identified by initials.
